mu_name_from: ZzzOpenData.cpp loads item group ITEM_ETC number i from Book{i+1:02}.bmd, so number 18 is Book19.bmd; MuMain's _enum.h names it ITEM_SCROLL_OF_NOVA = ITEM_ETC + 18 (and MODEL_SCROLL_OF_NOVA), and OpenMU's VersionSeasonSix/Items/Scrolls.cs carries it for the Soul Master. Season 2's, not 0.75's: the Soul Master's own spell (docs/golden-dragon-raid.md, Nova).
why_this_one: The user, 2026-10-07: 'lets first make that nova for soul master, than use it for dragon', then 'Scroll of Nova drop'. The scroll falls rarely in the Lost Tower and Atlans (sim::kNovaScrollOdds), read by a Soul Master alone.
mesh_note: No geometry of its own. Book01.bmd through Book19.bmd are byte-identical in MuMain's Data/Item -- one md5 across all nineteen -- so this names the one the pipeline has built, as Book02 through Book12 do.

stats.note: A scroll's row, in the shape of Book16's, at OpenMU's Season 6 numbers.
stats.classes_from: OpenMU's CharacterClasses.SoulMasterAndGrandMaster (VersionSeasonSix/SkillsInitializer.cs:158): the wizard's second alone.
stats.requires_note: OpenMU's Nova: level 100, energy 1,052 (VersionSeasonSix/SkillsInitializer.cs:158). The same numbers are on the skill block below, which is what Realm::useItem checks.
stats.drops_from_monsters_note: Not off the ordinary pools: its own roll in the Lost Tower and Atlans (Realm::leave, sim::kNovaScrollOdds), ours.

skill.note: What the scroll teaches. Read once and gone.
skill.name: Nova
skill.tells: Hold to gather power, up to twelve stages; let go and it bursts round him, striking every monster within six tiles, harder the longer he held.
skill.tells_from: The skill's own line in sim/skills.cpp, kept letter for letter so the scroll's tooltip and the skill's card say the same thing.
skill.level_from: OpenMU's level 100; the Soul Master is reached at 200 (Sevina, docs/class-change.md), so the level asks nothing more of him.
